sentences.text:
Shri Prakash Pancholi - learned counsel for the appell
 Shri Rajesh Joshi - learned Govt. Advocate for the res
 Order

This Criminal Appeal under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 11.04.2011 in Sessions Case No.181/2010 by the Second Additional Session Judge, Shajapur whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 376, 506 (Part-II), 323, 294 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 7 years R.I, 2 years R.I, 1 year R.I, 1 month R.I and fine of Rs.10,000/-, Rs. 5,000/-, Rs.1000 /-, Rs.500/-, respectively with default stipulation.
2.

This appeal arises out of the incident dated 06.06.2010 in which rape was committed with prosecutrix and regarding which a Crime No.67/10 was registered at Police Station chhapiheda ,
Rajgarh.
3.

The PUD No.1711/Warrant/2025 dated 25.06.2025 of Superintendent, Central Jail - Ujjain mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 14.03.2016 after completing the sentence and depositing the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21026 2 CRA-1012-2012 fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
